name: orchestration-engine
description: Computes the Complexity Vector (S, D, H) from local repo/git state, routes each task through the 3-level execution matrix (pipeline strategy, model tier, token cap), enforces the 3-way lifecycle (draft / ask-clarification / decline) across the SDLC pipeline agents, and records run history so agent-team decisions rest on data.

tier1Model.title: Level 3 (Macro Arch) model
tier1Model.description: Claude model used for Tier 1 / deep-reasoning tasks (M > 70).

tier2Model.title: Level 2 (Standard) model
tier2Model.description: Claude model used for Tier 2 / balanced tasks (15 <= M <= 70).

tier3Model.title: Level 1 (Micro-Task) model
tier3Model.description: Claude model used for Tier 3 / fast-cheap tasks (M < 15).

declineDHardCeiling.title: Decline gate D ceiling
declineDHardCeiling.description: Level 3 Dependency & Coupling Depth (D) value above which the engine aborts the task with a Decline (lack of info) instead of entering the isolation loop.

decisionTtlHours.title: Decision freshness window (hours)
decisionTtlHours.description: How long a computed orchestration decision stays valid for the Agent-call enforcement gate before it is considered stale and ignored.

sdlcAgentPattern.title: SDLC agent name pattern
sdlcAgentPattern.description: Regex (case-insensitive) matched against subagent_type/description to decide which Agent calls the enforcement gate should govern. Leave default unless your spec/eval/design/implementation/doc/testing agents use different naming.

churnWeight.title: Git churn weight (H)
churnWeight.description: Multiplier on 30-day git churn in H = churnWeight*churn + specDistanceWeight*cosineDistance. Spec default: 2.

specDistanceWeight.title: Spec distance weight (H)
specDistanceWeight.description: Multiplier on cosine distance to specs in H. Spec default: 50. Lower it if short tasks over-trigger Ask Clarification.

minEvalCycles.title: Level 3 min eval cycles
minEvalCycles.description: Independent evaluation cycles the spec-eval and tech-design-eval steps must complete at Level 3 (isolation loop).

maxEvalCycles.title: Eval cycle limit
maxEvalCycles.description: If an eval step still requests revisions after this many cycles the run is declined (isolation loop exhausted).

minConfidence.title: Minimum agent confidence
minConfidence.description: At Levels 2-3 a 'draft' decision reported with confidence below this value is downgraded to ask_clarification.

requireDecisionBlock.title: Require decision block
requireDecisionBlock.description: Block a pipeline agent from finishing once if its reply lacks the <decision>{...}</decision> block, so it can append one.
